name: Harley-Davidson Panhead
engine: 61 or 74 cu in air-cooled OHV V-twin, one carb, generator
intro: Harley's 1948-1965 big twin. Oil leaks, a correct engine and a sound front end are the big checks.

add.title: Find the oil leaks
add.instructions: Check the rocker covers, the oil pump and its return line, and the oil filter housing. Look for hairline cracks on cast pumps.
add.reason: Panheads are known for oil leaks, and a cracked pump line drips oil while stored.

A: Check the engine number is right for the year and model before you buy.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Rocker covers
known.what: The stock rocker covers are known for oil seepage.
